properties.notes: Planning permission 16/10493/FUL for 3 net additional homes (C3) granted on 10/02/2017. Prior approval 17/10127/PNRR for 2 net additional homes (C3) granted on 19/05/2017.. Erection of a first and second floor rear extension, redevelopment of the upper floors into 2 x 2-bedroom flats (C3) and 1 x 1-bedroom flat (C3), provision of communal amenity space on the flat roof on first floor and conversion of existing stores on the ground and first floor to refuse and cycle store. Change of use of rear of ground floor shop (A1) to residential use (C3) to form 2 x self-contained one-bedroom flats and removal of rooflight to create courtyard below and provision of balustrade.
